name: oracle
title: Price oracle
summary: Prices for any asset from many sources: every print is screened for manipulation, aggregated into a slew-limited published price with live, stale and seed status, daily history and baskets; staff watch sources and observations and post prices by hand.

env.name: ORACLE_PUBLISH_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often targets are recomputed and prices slew and publish (500ms to 1m).

env.name: ORACLE_SOURCES_ENABLED
env.doc: Poll sources. false keeps feeds on their seed or last price; pushed and staff prints still screen and publish (tests, air-gapped machines).

env.name: ORACLE_DISABLE_SOURCES
env.doc: Comma-separated source names not to poll (http).

env.name: ORACLE_LEARN_PREMIUMS
env.doc: Learn each venue's premium over the others and remove it before screening; a premium fixed on a source row always wins.

env.name: ORACLE_PUBLIC_READS
env.doc: Serve feeds, prices, history and observations without sign-in. false puts them behind sign-in.

env.name: ORACLE_PRICE_RETENTION
env.doc: How long published price points are kept (at least 24h); daily history is kept regardless.

env.name: ORACLE_OBSERVATION_RETENTION
env.doc: How long screened observations are kept (at least 720h; keep it above the longest feed lookback).

env.name: ORACLE_PRINTS_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: Staff prints allowed per admin per minute.

env.name: ORACLE_HTTP_MIN_GAP
env.doc: The http source's spacing between requests to one API host (at least 100ms).

env.name: ORACLE_HTTP_CADENCE
env.doc: How often the http source polls a source row without its own params.every (at least 10s).

env.name: ORACLE_DECISION_URL
env.doc: Decision model endpoint speaking the decisions format (state + yes/no questions), e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions. Unset = statistical screen only.

env.name: ORACLE_DECISION_MODEL
env.doc: Model id sent with each decision request (e.g. typesafe/jev-1.13); the answering snapshot is recorded on each observation.

env.name: ORACLE_DECISION_MAX_RPS
env.doc: Decision requests per second at most.

env.name: ORACLE_DECISION_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Time limit per decision request; on timeout the statistical verdict stands.

stitch: Decide who reads prices: anyone (default) or signed-in people (ORACLE_PUBLIC_READS=false); rename "Prices" in web/src/features/oracle/nav.ts and mobile/src/features/oracle/registry.tsx if the product calls them something else.
Create the feeds the product needs (Admin → Oracle → New feed, or the API) with a pace profile each; set a seed only when you trust it within ±30%.

Sources beyond JSON-HTTP: implement oracle.Source (and HistorySource for backfill) in your own package and oracle.RegisterSource(name, factory) from an init(), with one Task.Lane per API host and an honest Budget; push-only sources use oracle.RegisterPushSource and Service.Push.
Where one market is the truth, give its venue a fixed premium of 0 so learned premiums measure the others against it.
Consumers read Service.Current(ctx, key) or follow oracle.price (Service.OnPublish on the leader); treat stale and seed as "don't act".
Optionally set ORACLE_DECISION_URL, ORACLE_DECISION_API_KEY and ORACLE_DECISION_MODEL, and watch Admin → Oracle → Sources for calls, failures and cost.
Replace the dev seeds in backend/internal/oracle/seed.go (BTC-USD polls three public exchange APIs; the metals take seeded staff prints).
